title: C5G7 computational benchmark + BEAVRS experimental benchmark

use_for: verify C5G7 model identity and standard seven-group structure
evaluate six UO2/MOX placement layouts only after model gates pass
check candidate ranking and uncertainty handling within the C5G7 design space
C5G7.current_evidence: Corrected-group 18-run smoke dataset passed record integrity but selected no winner. The six-layout independent S_N transport run #39104899024 completed all six solver jobs; corrected posthoc artifact audit #39110583084 verified JSON/CSV consistency, all 6 layout signatures, patched source hashes, fixed reflectors, settings, and 1056 true fuel pins + 4 instrument tubes + 96 zero-power guide tubes per block. Full Python 3.12 regression #39110583360 passed 211 tests. The P4/P5 held-out OpenMC campaign is still in progress, so the cross-code comparison and P6 decision are not yet final.
C5G7.known_blocker: The independent S_N solver's pinned mesh-convergence study documents its expected -181.7 pcm residual at 16 cells per pin from Cartesian/digital-disk discretization; this is a known numerical bias, not a zero-bias oracle. The completed S_N screen is computational evidence only. Independent review of generated OpenMC model/tally mapping remains open, the P4/P5 held-out OpenMC campaign is incomplete, and no design-specific physical acceptance band exists for noncanonical layouts.
C5G7.crosscode_note: The S_N solver README and convergence.log report k_eff=1.184733 at 16 cells/pin, -181.7 pcm versus the NEA value; mesh refinement reduces the offset from about -3616 pcm at four cells/pin to -182 pcm at sixteen cells/pin. Treat it as a numerical comparator with a known discretization bias, not official acceptance.

integrity_findings: patched solver source SHA-256 matches layout metadata for all six layouts
source-derived layout signatures match layout metadata for all six layouts
five reflector positions remain fixed for all six layouts
CSV and JSON summary rows/counts agree
six_layout_independent_s_n_screen.convergence_caveat: Solver logs stop before maxout=800; source contains an internal tol=1e-5 stop rule, but detailed residuals are only printed every ten iterations and the exact terminal residual/iteration is not preserved. This is not an independent convergence certificate.

KRITZ2.preferred_case: KRITZ-2:19 MOX, cold and hot; use UO2 cases as additional cross-check if feasible
KRITZ2.required_model: finite experimental core model consistent with the OECD/NEA benchmark specification, including actual rod array, water height/leakage, boron, temperatures, densities, and material compositions
KRITZ2.invalid_shortcut: do not compare an infinite-lattice pin-cell k-infinity result directly with the experimental finite-core k-effective / participant-mean values
KRITZ2.current_status: deferred after user selected BEAVRS as the primary experimental pathway; do not use previous KRITZ pin-cell comparisons as validation

BEAVRS.selected_case: Cycle 1 day 0 tilt-corrected radial map restricted to the 58 instrumented labels
BEAVRS.status: three recorded runs completed; artifact-integrity checks passed for recorded run artifacts, but spatial-map agreement is poor and model-to-observable mismatch remains unresolved; NOT PHYSICALLY VALIDATED
known_mismatches: Upstream model temperature is 566.483 K versus reported inlet temperature 565.858 K (about 0.625 K difference).
SE=230 overrides upstream default 228 and exceeds generic helper's 228-step guard; geometry/sensitivity review is required.
Detector response is approximated by volume-integrated assembly fission rate; normalization covariance and per-position measurement uncertainty are not propagated.

gates.name: C5G7 model identity and standard group structure
gates.pass_condition: standard energy-group boundaries, source materials/geometry, and tally definitions independently reviewed
gates.note: Pinned C5G7 source and nonstandard log-spaced energy-group construction identified; CB-PFR patches generated MGXS to standard C5G7 group boundaries and audits the HDF5 group structure; actual generated XML/MGXS fidelity needs independent sign-off.

gates.name: C5G7 canonical convergence
gates.pass_condition: three independent high-budget seeds on corrected model; raw statepoints audited; benchmark comparison reproducible
gates.note: Six-layout independent S_N transport completed and corrected artifacts passed hash/layout/reflection/settings checks. P4/P5 high-budget OpenMC campaign and common-mask cross-code comparison remain incomplete. S_N source's internal tol=1e-5 stop rule is recorded, but retained logs do not include terminal residuals; do not claim independent convergence certification.

gates.name: BEAVRS full-core model preparation
gates.pass_condition: pinned source, nuclear data provenance, model geometry/settings, and measured state match audited
gates.note: Runs and integrity audits completed for recorded artifacts; SE=230 override and axial step-width assumptions still need sensitivity/model-state review.

gates.name: BEAVRS experimental map comparison
gates.pass_condition: successful OpenMC transport, 58 detector bins mapped, residuals reproduced from uploaded raw statepoint
gates.note: 58 detector labels map consistently, but fission-rate tally is not an exact detector response operator; spatial agreement is poor.

gates.name: BEAVRS uncertainty and model-mismatch review
gates.pass_condition: resolve bank-E mismatch or quantify its effect; include measurement and tally uncertainty and justified acceptance criteria
gates.note: Normalized RMSE up to 0.33426, Pearson correlation around -0.0780 to 0.03236, mean absolute relative error around 27.75%-29.00%; model-to-observable response and uncertainty treatment remain unresolved.

gates.name: QUBO-to-physical candidate mapping
gates.pass_condition: explicit candidate variables and constraints correspond to a physically defined candidate space
gates.note: The six enumerated 2x2 UO2/MOX layout candidates are explicit. This does not map legacy fresh/once_burned/twice_burned QUBO labels to BEAVRS or C5G7.

gates.name: CB-PFR physical effectiveness
gates.pass_condition: compare CB-PFR and baselines on the same physically evaluated candidate pool and common budget
gates.note: The six-layout independent S_N screen is complete but is not the OpenMC P5 ranking. P4/P5 held-out OpenMC campaign run #39098770358 remains active with jobs incomplete; the corrected cross-code posthoc workflow is waiting for all P4/P5 statepoints and raw-HDF5 re-audits. No P6 decision or physical effectiveness claim is established.

gates.name: Quantum-device evidence
gates.pass_condition: if claiming quantum execution/advantage, archive real device/annealer runs and fair classical baselines

explicit_nonclaims: C5G7 computational verification and BEAVRS experimental comparison are separate evidence streams.
A BEAVRS detector-map comparison does not validate all BEAVRS observables or every operating state.
A successful BEAVRS model comparison does not validate CB-PFR ranking or the legacy burnup-state QUBO mapping.
BEAVRS is not the same candidate space as the six C5G7 UO2/MOX layouts.
The six-layout QUBO cardinality penalty does not rank neutronically better layouts.
QUBO formulation alone does not prove quantum-device execution or quantum advantage.
No complete physical-validation claim is made until raw results, uncertainty, model mismatches and acceptance criteria are independently reviewed.
